records.text: An unidentified embedded commentator said Vladimir Putin personally asked Candace Owens to speak at the convention.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep YeEtS7nix3o)

appearances.snippet: So the latest is Putin himself has just asked Candace Owens to speak today at this convention.

verification.notes: The embedded clip establishes that an unidentified commentator made the claim, but live searches found no authoritative program record or Putin-office confirmation that Putin personally invited Owens to speak. Attempted but unverifiable.
